title: Separable-closure Cech section rings, coefficient maps and increment reindexing
statement: Let $k$ be a field and $\Omega/k$ a separable closure [def-pd-separable-closure], with both fields in a common universe $u$. Let $W_q$, $P_q=\operatorname{Aut}_k(\Omega)^{\operatorname{Fin}(q)}$ with its Krull topology, and the cumulative products $h_j(g)$ be those of [def-sfb-field-separable-cech-nerve]. For a normed field $A$ in universe $u$ with its metric topology, let $\underline A(S)=C(S,A)$ be its condensed ring [def-sfb-continuous-map-condensed-ring], and let $R_{A,X}=p_X^*\underline A$ be the pulled-back ring object [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients] on the small pro-etale site of a scheme $X$ in universe $u$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Define the section ring $\operatorname{sections}_{k,\Omega}(A,q)=\Gamma(W_q,R_{A,\operatorname{Spec}k})$ by evaluating the commutative section-ring sheaf [def-weil-pbc-internal-abelian-sheaf-module-equivalence] at the actual nerve object $W_q$, with its induced multiplication and unit. For normed fields $A,B$ in universe $u$ and a continuous field homomorphism $\varphi:A\to B$, define $\operatorname{coefficientMap}_X(\varphi)=p_X^*(\varphi_*)$, using the postcomposition morphism $\varphi_*$ of [def-sfb-continuous-map-condensed-ring-map]. For $n,m\geq0$, an order-preserving simplex map $\alpha:\{0,\ldots,n\}\to\{0,\ldots,m\}$ and $g\in P_m$, define $\operatorname{reindex}(\alpha,g)\in P_n$ by $\operatorname{reindex}(\alpha,g)_j=h_{\alpha(j)}(g)^{-1}h_{\alpha(j+1)}(g)$ for $0\leq j<n$. The products are ordered compositions of field automorphisms. These are definitions, not assertions of coordinate existence or any comparison isomorphism. No nonarchimedean, completeness or algebraic-closedness assumption is imposed on $A$ or $B$.
